in_sanskrit.name: Shiwa
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess of Fertility
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Shiwa एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Shiwa is a Hindu goddess revered as the goddess of fertility, love, and motherhood. She is often depicted with multiple arms holding various symbols of creation, abundance, and protection.
